en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a lakeside railway track with a man walking along the rails. On the right stands a large ornate wooden hotel building with balconies and a tower-like roof. Trees and forested hills rise behind the hotel, and water with small wooden structures lies to the left. At the top, red printed text in Swedish identifies the location and the hotel.
